gloss: free call; toll-free call; free calling

definitions.gloss: free call; toll-free call; free calling

examples.japanese: LINEで{無料通話|むりょうつうわ}ができる。
examples.english: You can make free calls on LINE.

examples.japanese: このプランには{月|つき}60{分|ぷん}の{無料通話|むりょうつうわ}が{含|ふく}まれている。
examples.english: This plan includes 60 minutes of free calls per month.

examples.japanese: {海外|かいがい}にいる{家族|かぞく}とも、インターネットを{使|つか}えば{無料通話|むりょうつうわ}で{話|はな}せるので{助|たす}かっている。
examples.english: I'm grateful that I can talk to my family overseas for free using internet calling.

notes:
A compound of {無料|むりょう} (free of charge) + {通話|つうわ} (phone call). In modern usage, this term most commonly refers to free voice calls made through messaging apps (LINE, WhatsApp) or VoIP services, but it also applies to toll-free numbers and free calling minutes included in phone plans.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {無料通話|むりょうつうわ}アプリ: free calling app
- {無料通話|むりょうつうわ}{分|ぶん}: free calling minutes (included in a plan)
- {無料通話|むりょうつうわ}をかける: to make a free call
- {無料通話|むりょうつうわ}{対応|たいおう}: supports free calling

SIMILAR WORDS:
- フリーダイヤル: toll-free number (specifically a 0120-number that the receiver pays for)
- {通話料|つうわりょう}{無料|むりょう}: call charges free (alternative phrasing; same meaning)
- {国際電話|こくさいでんわ}: international call (often contrasted with {無料通話|むりょうつうわ} apps that make international calls free)
